name: Warm Steamed Premium White Calrose Rice Bowl
whyItWorks: Pure steamed short-grain white rice is one of the safest foods on earth for active inflammatory bowel disease. It is non-allergenic, virtually fiber-free, easy to absorb, and actively soothes hyperactive intestines.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order plain steamed white rice without sushi vinegar seasoning, sesame seeds, or sauce.
